data.question: Can Katherine Hsiao be directly attributed to specific Global Future Council for Data Policy outputs?
data.method: Review current WEF profile, publication metadata, launch page, and direct artifact links; preserve failed PDF retrieval as a source gap.
data.scope: Term/roster attribution and Pathways to Digital Justice contributor attribution.
findings: WEF's current Hsiao profile says she recently served on the Global Future Council for Data Policy but provides no exact term dates.

WEF's Pathways to Digital Justice publication page exposes an official www3.weforum.org PDF download and attributes the paper at the council/collaboration level rather than to Hsiao individually in the HTML metadata.

WEF's October 2021 white-paper launch page names Evîn Cheikosman, Sophie Compton, Wafa Ben-Hassine, Sean McDonald, JoAnn Stonier and Shireen Mitchell as speakers, moderated by Sheila Warren; Hsiao is not named on that launch-page speaker list.
Direct retrieval of the official WEF PDF timed out, preventing contributor-page inspection in this environment.
A deterministic WEF artifact collector was added to the repository to discover, download, hash and optionally text-extract official WEF PDFs without writing directly to canonical db records.
conclusions: Hsiao-to-council membership remains directly verified; Hsiao-to-specific-publication contribution remains unresolved and should not be promoted without named credit.
limitations: Search-index and launch-page coverage can miss names present only inside the PDF or archived council pages.
